title: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability…
description: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg versions before 3.2.12 contain an incorrect authorization vulnerability. This flaw affects the Posts Grid block and Atomic Wind query loop, allowing users with Contributor-level permissions to read non-public post type entries. Attackers can manipulate block attributes to access titles and text of restricted post types such as flamingo_inbound or shop_coupon, and the Atomic Wind custom_field path leaks protected post meta data.
